matters.matter: Completion of Nvidia's announced Hugging Face acquisition by the check date
matters.why: Closing the acquisition would use substantial cash and add a developer platform, and public announcements can settle its status by the check date.

matters.matter: New HBM production capacity brought online by SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung in 2027, including its timing
matters.why: The amount and timing of capacity could affect Nvidia's GPU supply, and producers' reports can establish what came online in 2027.

matters.matter: Whether the HBM shortage eases in 2027
matters.why: The supply-demand balance can constrain Nvidia's output and affect costs independently of how much capacity is added, and public market reports can assess it for 2027.

matters.matter: Nvidia's outstanding supply and purchase commitments at its next annual report
matters.why: The commitments affect Nvidia's future cash obligations and will be disclosed in its annual report.

matters.matter: Global semiconductor industry revenue in calendar 2026
matters.why: The total includes many chips outside Nvidia's business, so it does not by itself warrant a separate card on Nvidia.
AI-chip sales describe a market central to Nvidia's revenue and competitive position, and public industry estimates can assess the year's sales.

matters.matter: Timing of first shipments of Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 Rubin Ultra rack platform
matters.why: A delay could affect when Nvidia earns revenue from the platform, and public product and customer reports can establish when it ships.

matters.matter: Global HBM shipment growth in calendar 2027
matters.why: HBM availability can affect Nvidia's ability to supply its systems, and public industry reports can estimate shipments for the year.

matters.matter: Whether HBM supply remains below demand in calendar 2027
matters.why: A shortage can constrain Nvidia's output and raise costs even if shipments grow, and public market reports can assess the balance for the year.
